---
title: Focus ring author override
format:
  html:
    theme: [default, focus-ring-author-override.scss]
---

Fixture for author focus styles. The theme sets its own outline on
`a:focus-visible` and removes the Quarto inner tone with
`--quarto-focus-ring-shadow: none`. The author rule must win over the
global focus ring.

An [inline link](#target) in the body.

## Target {#target}
